roi.selection: Fixed after visual inspection of all b1000 images; excludes outer boundary from interior and reserves distant top corners as empirical background. No scan-specific threshold used for measurement.

kspace.method: Imaging-only complex ADC samples reordered to the same centered ky rows used for images. No FFT of magnitude images. Off and deramp modes; all raw imaging energy conserved on row permutation.
kspace.display: log10(1+|K| / 1 acquisition unit); shared offset and limits within each b column; no per-scan normalization
kspace.limitations: Positive noise power retained, not noise-subtracted. Fractions describe distribution rather than SNR. ky map conditional on predecessor implementation; readout index not calibrated physical kx.
